title: Human Activity Classification Under Domain and Temporal Shift
description: Unreleased development revision of a research and engineering portfolio spanning POLAR, V-COCO, and Okutama-Action. It preserves the earlier versioned confirmation studies and adds the completed ARFTR development phase: 85.383648% macro-F1 on 4,977 adaptively reused examples, not independent confirmation. The final matched shared motion-null experiment failed its fixed continuation gates and ARFTR remains retained. Includes source code, negative results, model limitations, an aggregate-only evidence package and current reproducibility checks. Dataset media, pretrained checkpoints and qualitative source-image composites are not included. This metadata does not indicate that a new release or deposit has been published.
